typography.headings: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.card_style: flat rectangular with 1px subtle border, rounded-xl, shadow-sm bg-white p-6
visual_enhancers.surface: solid background with subtle frosted glass header backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200

accessibility.contrast_ratio: minimum 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI elements
accessibility.test_attributes: all interactive elements have data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React fullstack application for Small Business Income, Expenses, Invoices, Inventory, Expenses (3 tabs), and Todos with per-user activity audit logs.
Support two accounts: admin (Kullanıcı 1) and user2 (Kullanıcı 2) with demo quick login buttons.
Invoices: Automatically compute 20% VAT-inclusive breakdown and monthly VAT totals. Support Excel/PDF upload simulation with preview and confirmation dialog.
Inventory: Automatically compute remaining quantity = needed - received (or initial stock tracker).
Expenses: Three distinct tabs (Şirket Harcamaları, Kullanıcı 1 Harcamaları, Kullanıcı 2 Harcamaları) with automatic totals.
Gelirler, Giderler, Faturalar: Auto-date on creation, dynamic table lists with add, edit, delete, and automatic bottom totals.
Todos: Task name, notes, completion timestamp toggle, delete.
Activity Log: Real-time user action tracking with date, time, user name, and action description.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tables, and tabs have proper data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Never use full transparent headers without blur or scrim
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8 for cards)
Always set explicit text color on hover
Include data-testid on all interactive elements
